lines.zh: 五合一的身子，一步就是几格。
lines.en: Five in one; each stride covers blocks.
Five bodies' weight presses the ground.

lines.zh: 我每一步都震得石子跳
lines.en: Every step makes the pebbles jump.
I move through the valley.
The light in my seams never goes out.
I head for the smell of ore.

lines.zh: 我的部件发出低频的响
lines.en: My parts give off a low hum.
Slow, but nothing can stop me.
I leave deep prints on the ridge.
I skirt a cliff edge.

lines.zh: 我朝山下有声音的地方走
lines.en: I descend toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我的甲片在阳光下反光
lines.en: My armor plates glint in the sun.
I stand, and the cliff echoes.
The light in my seams flows slowly.
Three and a half blocks, grown on scrap.
This body is still settling.

lines.zh: 我把拳头握紧又松开，X-Attack 在等。
lines.en: I clench and release my fist; X-Attack waits.
The stone under me has cracked.
I have no need to breathe.
I look up at the clouds.
My parts settle one by one.
I wait for the anchor's call.
I am quiet, and very heavy.
I look down at these hands.
Only wind in these mountains.

lines.zh: 我把重心从一条腿换到另一条
lines.en: I shift my weight from one leg to the other.
You are very small before me.
I must crouch to see you clearly.
You need not fear me.
I always walk slowly.

lines.zh: 你站在我的影子里，很小。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow, very small.
I raised a hand; nothing more.
What do you want to say?
I am listening here.
Your voice sounds distant.
That is because I am tall.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，地面陷了一点
lines.en: I sit, and the ground sinks a little.
You come up to my knee.
My hand is larger than you are.
Touch it if you like.
I will not move; rest easy.
There is only us here.
A seam has split.
I take a step back.

lines.zh: 我五个拼在一起，才这么高。
lines.en: Five of us joined to stand this tall.
I can still stand firm.
I brace my body steady.
Do not touch my seams.
The light dimmed a little.
I can still move.

lines.zh: 我五具身体压在地上，记着这一下。
lines.en: Five bodies pressed to the ground, I remember that blow.

lines.zh: 这一击卡进我甲片的接缝。
lines.en: That blow wedges into the seam of my armor.
Is that a piece of ore?
I bend down toward you.
This small piece is too small.
But I accept it anyway.
I hold it between two fingers.
It grows hot in my palm.
I thank you for this.
Do you have more over there?
Not enough to fill one seam.
But it tastes good.
I open my palm.
Set the thing here.
You hit my leg and bounced off.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我膝甲上
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my knee guard.
My toe nearly came down on you.
My foot is bigger than you are.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫起一片尘土
lines.en: My tail sweeps up a cloud of dust.
I take a long time to turn.
Do not stay by my feet.
You made my seams ring.
That bump does not matter.
I try to stand still.
This body of mine is too large.
Coming near me takes care.
I sit myself down.
Now you can reach me.
Five bodies, one intention.
That intention has always been you.
I keep watch here.
Sleep a while.

lines.zh: 五体合一的 X 攻击。
lines.en: Five-in-one X-Attack.
I will wake you at dawn.
I bend, and every seam sounds.
It feels like a grain of sand in my hand.
A pinch of two fingers crushes it.
This thing isn't worth closing my fist on.
This ore is worth keeping.
I chew a mouthful to test.
This taste is quite pure.
I tuck it into a seam.
Do you have more?
I will watch over it.
You don't even reach my waist.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，整片山谷都响
lines.en: I lower myself; the whole valley rings.
This one lands heavily.
I worked out the distance long ago.
No need to retreat; it will not help.
My fist is clenched.
The light in my seams has brightened.
This one is shaped like an X.
Then I move first.
This time I use everything.
You have one instant.
Right at this moment.
I turn with your direction.
I turn slowly, but I cover much.
You are within my arm's reach.
I can strike without closing in.

lines.zh: 我在等一个更稳的角度
lines.en: I wait for a steadier angle.
You have gone behind the cliff.
That cannot stop me.
One punch can level this area.
Wait a tiny bit more.
You finally showed yourself.
Then let us fight.
In this very moment.
My fist smashes down.
The ground splits wide.
You are thrown by the shock.
An X of light slices through.
Every part of me rings.
I did not hold back.
You are still moving.
That is truly impressive.
One seam has come loose.
Then one more blow.
This one will be heavier.

lines.zh: 你要是躲不开，就别硬扛
lines.en: If you cannot dodge, do not try to take it.
Five bodies fall from the sky.
They join in midair.
The valley shakes when I land.

lines.zh: 接缝里的光第一次全亮
lines.en: The light in my seams comes fully alive.
I raise my head above the ridge.
The wind goes around my body.
The stone beneath me turns to powder.
There is plenty of ore here.
I have caught the scent.

lines.zh: 我的锚点就在这座山上
lines.en: My anchor is on this mountain.
I take one step up the mountain.
The cliff face cracked.
My seams glow red with heat.
I crash down and sink into the earth.
Water pours in through every seam.

lines.zh: 冲击把两个身体分开了
lines.en: The blast separates two of my bodies.

lines.zh: 一根东西卡进我的胸口
lines.en: Something is lodged in my chest.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的接缝全在抖
lines.en: That force sets every seam trembling.

lines.zh: 没有矿石，我撑不了太久
lines.en: Without ore, I cannot last long.

lines.zh: 雷走过我的每一块部件
lines.en: Lightning runs through every part of me.

lines.zh: 我这么重也落不到地上
lines.en: Even this weight cannot reach ground.
